Market Notice Details

Notice_PRR_SCR@lists.ercot.com,Notice_Operations@lists.ercot.com

Sent:

9/30/26, 10:06 AM

Subject:

M-A093026-01 Implementation Details of NOGRR226, Addition of Supplemental UFLS Stages, and NOGRR247, Change UFLS Stages and Load Relief Amounts

NOTICE DATE:

September 30, 2026

NOTICE TYPE:

M-A093026-01 NPRR

SHORT DESCRIPTION:
 Implementation Details of NOGRR226, Addition of Supplemental UFLS Stages, and NOGRR247, Change UFLS Stages and Load Relief Amounts

INTENDED AUDIENCE:
 All Market Participants

DAYS AFFECTED:
 November 1, 2026

LONG DESCRIPTION:
 On November 1, 2026, Nodal Operating Guide language associated with Nodal Operating Guide Revision Request (NOGRR) 226, Addition of Supplemental UFLS Stages; and NOGRR247, Change UFLS Stages and Load Relief Amounts, will be implemented.

NOGRR226 and NOGRR247 include new anti-stall Under-Frequency Load Shed (UFLS) stages and expand UFLS from three standard stages to five .

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

In accordance with Nodal Operating Guide Section 1.3.5, Nodal Operating Guide Revision Implementation, ERCOT provides notice as soon as practicable, but no later than ten days prior to implementation.

NOGRR226
 and 
NOGRR247
 and associated documents can be found on the ERCOT website. 

CONTACT:
 If you have any questions, please contact your ERCOT Account Manager. You may also call the general ERCOT Client Services phone number at (512) 248-3900 or contact ERCOT Client Services via email at 
ClientServices@ercot.com
.
